# metronome_pricing_unit (Data Source)

A pricing unit (the API calls it a credit type), found by name: a currency such as `USD (cents)`, or a custom unit of the account. Its ID is what `fiat_credit_type_id` and `credit_type_id` take.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "metronome_pricing_unit" "usd" {
  name = "USD (cents)"
}

resource "metronome_rate_card" "standard" {
  name                = "Standard"
  fiat_credit_type_id = data.metronome_pricing_unit.usd.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The unit's name, exactly as Metronome shows it, for example `USD (cents)`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unit's Metronome ID.
- `is_currency` (Boolean) Whether the unit is a currency, as opposed to a custom pricing unit.
